title: Prepositions of Place: IN, ON, AT
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Ahora sabes cómo usar IN, ON y AT para describir ubicaciones y lugares.

parts.visual: IN (Dentro de un espacio o áreas grandes): in the office, in the meeting room, in London, in Mexico. ON (Sobre una superficie o línea): on the desk, on the wall, on the second floor, on the internet.
parts.audio: IN means inside a space or large areas: in the office, in the meeting room, in London. ON means on a surface or line: on the desk, on the second floor, or on the internet.

parts.visual: AT (Un punto específico o evento): at the entrance, at the reception, at my desk (sentado frente a él), at the meeting. Excepciones: at work (en el trabajo), at home (en casa).
parts.audio: AT means a specific point or event: at the entrance, at the reception, at my desk, or at the meeting. Exceptions: at work and at home.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige in, on, o at según corresponda para lugares.

questions.question: The manager is ____ the meeting room. (Dentro de).
questions.explanation: Dentro de un espacio cerrado = in.

questions.question: The report is ____ the desk. (Sobre la superficie).
Someone is waiting ____ the reception. (Punto específico).
questions.explanation: Un punto específico del edificio = at.

questions.question: The IT department is ____ the second floor. (Superficie/Nivel).
I saw the news ____ the internet. (Plataforma/Red).
He is not here. He is ____ a conference. (Evento).
Please sign ____ the bottom of the page. (Punto específico).
questions.explanation: Top y bottom de una página = at.

questions.question: Put the files ____ the cabinet. (Dentro de).
There is a notice ____ the wall. (Superficie vertical).
I am sitting ____ my desk right now. (En mi lugar de trabajo/Punto).
questions.explanation: Sentado frente al escritorio = at my desk. ('on my desk' sería literalmente sentado encima del escritorio).

questions.question: I left my keys ____ the car. (Dentro del vehículo cerrado).
I am reading the report ____ my laptop. (Dispositivo electrónico).
The client is waiting ____ the entrance. (Punto específico).
There is a mistake ____ page 4. (Superficie del papel).
I have the information ____ my folder. (Dentro de).
Are you still ____ work? (En el trabajo).
The meeting is ____ room 302. (Dentro de).
questions.explanation: Dentro de un cuarto numerado = in.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la preposición correcta de lugar: in, on, at.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The manager is in the meeting room.
options: The manager is in the meeting room.
The manager is at the meeting room.
The manager is on the meeting room.
The boss is in the meeting room.
questions.correct_answer: The manager is in the meeting room.

The report is at the desk.
The folder is on the desk.

Someone is waiting on the reception.
